description: This Dart file defines a SearchProvider class that manages search query parameters, filters, and results for a Flutter app, specifically for listing/search pages related to books. It interacts with CatalogService to fetch book data and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: SearchProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier subclass that manages search query text, selected category, price range, loading state, and search results for listing/search pages.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the selected category filter and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setPriceRange
methods.description: Sets the minimum and maximum price filters and notifies listeners.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search by fetching book data from CatalogService based on current filters and updates the pagination results; manages loading state and notifications.
